title: No Spore Blossom particles
body:
**Invisible Spore Blossom Particles**

The Spore Blossom is one of the most beautiful decorative plants in Minecraft, but its constant green "dust" and dripping particles can often clutter a build or ruin the atmosphere of a custom map. This resource pack completely silences those particles, leaving you with just the flower.

**Features:**

Total Transparency:
Removes both the floating ambient particles and the dripping particles.

Vanilla Flower Texture: The pink Spore Blossom block itself remains untouched, only the particles are hidden.
